caption:
Cajun Chicken Pita Pocket with a Cucumber Salad & Coriander Dressing 
high protein | 30 minute recipe | meal prep friendly | lunch box series 

Nutrition: 
C: 52 | F: 13 | P: 57
Calories: 551 per serve ( 2 pitas ) 
Serves 3 portions 

Ingredients 
450 grams chicken breast
marinade: 
1 tbsp cajun seasoning
minced garlic 
1 - 2 tbsp greek yogurt
salt + pepper to taste
1 tsp peri peri masala
1/2 lemon, juiced

1 tsp olive oil 
1 onion, thinly sliced
1 capsicum, cubed or sliced
1 tsp garlic

cucumber salsa 
1 cucumber, small cubes
1 lemon juice 
handful chopped coriander 
pinch of salt 

dip
3 - 4 tbsp greek yogurt
1 lemon’s juice
coriander leaves
2-3 cloves garlic
1 tsp chaat masala 
salt, to taste if needed

6 pita pockets / 4 rotis / bread works good too 

Method
marinate the chicken in the ingredients mentioned and leave till you need to use it
in a pan, add oil, garlic, onions and capsicum and cook well, take it out and set aside 
add in the chicken and saute til its cooked through and add the onion, capsicum mix back in and leave till ready to assemble 

cucumber salsa is simple, combine all the ingredients and set aside to marinate for 1 hour

the dip comes together simply in a blender, just add all the ingredients and blitz till blended together
